title: NIST AI RMF: What Every Security Team Should Know
content_md: What Is the NIST AI RMF? The NIST AI Risk Management Framework (NIST AI 100-1) is a voluntary guidance document released on January 26, 2023. It gives organizations a common structure for identifying, measuring, and managing AI system risks across the lifecycle [1]. Article Link: NIST AI RMF: What Every Security Team Should Know
